clips.title: The story
paras: In Thunder Bluff, the tauren seek a dryad phial filled with moonwell water. Its rare spiritual power can quench the eternal flame shielding a sacred centaur relic.

To fill the phial, you must enter night elf territory deep in Ashenvale. Dryads around Raynewood Retreat carry the empty vessels, crafted to hold pure restorative draughts. A sacred moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River fills the phial with water rich in celestial and nature-bound power. Night elves regard taking it without leave as desecration. The tauren see the water as vital to meeting a threat farther south.
